triggered_rules.description: Conflicting ownership claims detected on submitted recording.
Partial acoustic fingerprint match against an existing recording.
Uploading account is less than 30 days old.
Structured statement of reasons emitted per DSA Art 17.
Decision routed to human reviewer (GDPR Art 22 / AI Act Art 14 / DSA Art 20).
Policy version and decision recorded for accountability (GDPR Arts 5(2), 24).

DSA Art 17 \u2014 statement of reasons.action_scope: submission-level; no duration set by this system
DSA Art 17 \u2014 statement of reasons.contractual_ground: distributor terms: metadata, ownership and originality requirements

plain_english_explanation: This submission has been held for review by a person before anything takes effect. The decision was made by an automated system using policy version 0.1.0. The system's confidence in the assessment behind it is 0.500 (Human-Review-Required). The assessment relied on the following observations: more than one party claims ownership of this recording; the audio partially matches an existing recording; the uploading account was created less than 30 days ago. A person will look at this before it takes effect. You can also contest it or ask about it via: internal-complaint-v1. This record is a readiness signal produced by compliance-support software. It is not a legal determination and does not constitute legal advice.
